```{=html}
<style>
.amr-course-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--course-columns, 2), minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1.75rem;
  margin-block: 1.5rem 3rem;
}
.amr-course-card {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid #cfe3f7;
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(3, 60, 115, .08);
  font-family: inherit;
  transition: transform 220ms ease, box-shadow 220ms ease, border-color 220ms ease;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .amr-course-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    border-color: #94bfe9;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 42px rgba(3, 60, 115, .14);
  }
}
.amr-course-card:focus-within {
  border-color: #94bfe9;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 42px rgba(3, 60, 115, .14);
}
.amr-course-card .amr-course-image {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  margin: 0;
}
.amr-course-footer {
  padding: clamp(1.1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
  border-top: 1px solid #dce9f8;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #fff, #f0f7ff);
  text-align: center;
}
.amr-course-footer .amr-course-status {
  display: inline-block;
  margin: 0 0 1.2rem;
  padding: .25rem .8rem;
  border: 1px solid #fecaca;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #fef2f2;
  color: #b42318;
  font-size: .85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.amr-course-actions {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .75rem;
}
.amr-course-actions a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: .6rem;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: .7rem .65rem;
  border: 1px solid #a9cbea;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #fff;
  color: #033c73;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: .95rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: box-shadow 180ms ease;
}
.amr-course-actions .amr-course-pay {
  border-color: transparent;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #033c73, #0466c8, #147ed5);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(4, 102, 200, .18);
}
.amr-course-actions a:hover {
  color: #033c73 !important;
  background: #eaf4ff;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(3, 60, 115, .16);
}
.amr-course-actions .amr-course-pay:hover,
.amr-course-actions .amr-course-pay:focus-visible {
  color: #fff !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #022e59, #0357ae, #106dc0);
}
.amr-course-actions svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.8;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  transition: transform 180ms ease;
}
.amr-course-actions a:hover svg { transform: translateX(-3px); }
.amr-course-actions a:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #0466c8;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .amr-course-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 380px) {
  .amr-course-actions { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .amr-course-card { transition: none; }
  .amr-course-card:hover { transform: none; }
  .amr-course-actions a { transition: none; }
  .amr-course-actions svg { transition: none; }
  .amr-course-actions a:hover svg { transform: none; }
}
</style>
```
